_help: Manual assessment per document (file name without .pdf). level: high, medium or low. Written after a person compared pages with the PDF; it overrides the automatic level and its note is kept as the argument.

STANAG_2015.note: scanned field manual read through its OCR text layer. Visual comparison of pages 33, 69 and 172 with the PDF (12 Nov 2026): paragraphs readable; figures, formulas, table columns and figure or table numbers contain errors (for example 'Table 2-b' for 'Table 2-4'). Rules from this document must be checked on the PDF page. Pages 170 to 181 are symbol tables and figures (map symbols, buoys): no rules in them. Pages 184 to 297 mix road signs and text (observed by hand, 12 Nov 2026).

STANAG_2174_alternative.note: scanned field manual (FM 55-30) read through its OCR text layer. Automatic check: 99.7% of words kept, 9 pages above 5% loss. Hand comparison (12 Nov 2026): pages 34, 62, 70 read correctly as text; page 62 also holds a diagram (trailer transfer points, distances 90, 90, 53 mi) that the automatic check did not detect; page 70 figure detected. Figures without a caption are not detected on a scanned manual, so every rule must be compared with the PDF page.
